description: The City of Calgary publishes laboratory and flow measurements for treated effluent from its wastewater treatment plants. The documented series begins in 2007 and is reported monthly to Alberta Environment and Protected Areas. Fields identify the sample site, coordinates, sample date, measured parameter, numeric and formatted results, units and result qualifiers. Most laboratory measurements use daily 24-hour composite samples; fecal coliform measurements use grab samples. These observations can support wastewater-treatment performance assessment and water-quality model calibration. Sampling locations and analytical methods have changed, including detection limits and accredited parameters, so comparisons require attention to those changes.
